scope: Development capability observations only. Query-path checks use frozen historical pure logic; fee/nonce/header observations are current-specific and do not enable production measurements.
limits: Both providers may share underlying node/client behavior; this is not an independent execution oracle.
No fresh runtime-code hashes for token/Pool dependencies, malicious-override controls, signature validation, paid infrastructure, signing or broadcasts.
Header witnesses may expose a synthetic BASEFEE. No unchanged-header label is assumed.
Anchors classify only the observed sender nonce under the exact tested wrapper; they do not prove every storage account or arbitrary state transition.
Recorded cases are development controls, not prospective or representative accuracy evidence.
